note: The google-cloud MCP server answers in prose with a row preview; `bq` returns JSON. Requires the emulator started for this task: uv run python server/fakes/gcp.py live-transactions. Every google-cloud projection ends in `grep .`, so an arm whose reply carries no such line fails the case instead of agreeing on nothing.

cases.name: run_query_count
cases.why: the same statement returns the same answer through either arm

args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM transactions_analytics.live_transactions

mirage.command: google-cloud bigquery-run-query '{"query":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM transactions_analytics.live_transactions"}'
